testIsolation: Private fixture profiles and temporary projects; no actual user project modified or deleted

limits.RAM: Windows committed process/job memory; Linux/Android per-process virtual address space
limits.CPU: Windows hard Job Object rate cap; unavailable on other local runners
limits.GPU: Library visibility policy only; no arbitrary GPU percentage quota
limits.disk: Working-folder size monitoring; may overshoot until next 750ms check; outside-folder writes not covered
limits.cellTime: Wall clock per cell, kills kernel
limits.notebookTime: Accumulated execution across cells until kernel restart; excludes idle

limitations: Local development build, not a stable release or full CLion replacement.
Physical Sora, Android IME and tablet gestures are not verified by this run.
Separate native project windows are implemented and tested on Windows, not on Android.
Linux/macOS GUI, managed interpreter installations and installers are not verified here.
Unsigned Windows setup was built and extracted, not system-installed.
Third-party addons remain data-only; full executable addon SDK and total feature separation remain unfinished.
One backend test exceeded its 60-second timeout while multiple GUI suites and installer compression ran concurrently; a separate sequential rerun is recorded below.

installer.guiRuntime: existing Electron runtime on packaged resources/app

desktopBackend.skipReason: LLDB DAP is supported on macOS/Linux; Windows uses GDB

earlierConcurrentAttempt.reason: GCC bits/std::print regression exceeded 60 seconds during simultaneous installer compression and GUI runs
